import pandas as pd

file_path = '/data/sahyog_budget_and_receipts.xlsx'
df_raw = pd.read_excel(file_path, sheet_name='Finance FY25-26', header=None)
# Find start of donor receipts
# Look for row with 'Receipt ID' in first column
start_idx = None
for i in range(len(df_raw)):
    if df_raw.iloc[i,0] == 'Receipt ID':
        start_idx = i
        break
print('start_idx', start_idx)
# Extract data rows
if start_idx is not None:
    cols = df_raw.iloc[start_idx].tolist()
    print('cols', cols)
    data = df_raw.iloc[start_idx+1:].copy()
    # Find where TOTAL RECEIPTS appears
    # Stop before row where first column is TOTAL RECEIPTS
    end_idx = None
    for i in range(start_idx+1, len(df_raw)):
        if str(df_raw.iloc[i,0]).strip().upper() == 'TOTAL RECEIPTS':
            end_idx = i
            break
    print('end_idx', end_idx)
    data = data.iloc[:end_idx-start_idx-1]
    # Assign columns
    data.columns = cols
    # Keep only relevant columns
    print(data.head())
    print('shape', data.shape)
    # Filter Donor Type exactly 'Foreign Grant'
    filtered = data[data['Donor Type'] == 'Foreign Grant']
    print('filtered count rows', len(filtered))
    distinct_ids = filtered['Receipt ID'].nunique()
    print('distinct IDs', distinct_ids)
    print(filtered[['Receipt ID','Donor Type']])
